target.validation_method: root SSH target probe; no computer-use visual inspection

build_validation.input_ring: 256 records x 32 bytes; FPGA producer, ARM consumer; keyboard/mouse/joystick/focus edge capture
build_validation.ddr_arbiter: Audio priority, input next, framebuffer/control fallback; outstanding reads response-locked
build_validation.host_and_arm_tests: Transport control, framebuffer scanout, PCM ordering/starvation/recovery, long 480-record PCM drain, DDR arbiter, input capture/overflow, host ABI and Cortex-A9 QEMU checks passed.

hardware_validation.clean_boot: Board rebooted, new RBF loaded, and FPGA manager reported operating.
hardware_validation.control_attachment: ARM probe reported epoch 0xd1a61001 and fpga_state=ready.
hardware_validation.input_idle: ARM probe observed a stable attached input ring with producer=consumer=0 for two seconds.
hardware_validation.pcm_queue: On a clean boot of the same RBF, ARM published 480 stereo S16 records and FPGA consumed the queue to producer=consumer=480.
hardware_validation.framebuffer_regression: On a clean boot of the same RBF, two ARM-published frames were claimed by FPGA scanout and the retired slot was reclaimed.

scope_limit: Physical keyboard/mouse/controller edge injection, ARM snapshot recovery after overflow, physical left/right audio channel inspection, real Diablo launch and frame-pacing qualification remain open.
